# Benjamin McKenzie — Company Formation Insights

## About
Expert insights on Hong Kong company formation, compliance, and business setup by Benjamin McKenzie. Practical guides for founders and entrepreneurs establishing companies in Hong Kong.

## Author
Benjamin McKenzie is a Company Formation Specialist based in Hong Kong. He helps foreign entrepreneurs navigate the process of setting up companies in Hong Kong, from registration to compliance.

## Key Topics
- Hong Kong company registration
- Annual compliance requirements
- Bank account opening for foreign companies
- Offshore tax exemption (FSIE regime)
- Business setup for foreign entrepreneurs

## Latest Articles
- [How to Register a Hong Kong Company in 2026](https://benjaminmckenzie.com/articles/hong-kong-company-registration-2026.html) — Complete guide covering registration process, requirements, timelines, and costs.
